summary:
Implemented the rich_measure feature. Changes: (1) rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__, an iterative stack-based walk that measures each label with the unmodified max_width, adds 4*level indent, and returns Measurement(min, max); imports Measurement from .measure. (2) rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__ returning "Align(<renderable repr>, <align repr>)", and a new VerticalCenter(JupyterMixin) class after Align with a render method that emits top/bottom newline padding from console.size.height (negative counts skipped) and a measurement method delegating to Measurement.get. (3) tests/test_align.py: imports VerticalCenter; added repr, VerticalCenter render (expects "

foo


" at height 6), and VerticalCenter measure (3,3) tests. (4) tests/test_tree.py: imports Measurement between console and tree; added test_measure_tree expecting Measurement(11, 19). (5) CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 heading marked Unreleased, added Added subsection with the two entries, kept the existing markdown line. Not done: the optional secondary Align width and print justify behaviors (not judged, not needed by existing tests). Tests were not run, per instructions; all verification was by reading. Nothing committed.
